The vendor directly providing **Mailchimp** at **mailchimp.com** is **The Rocket Science Group LLC** (doing business as **Mailchimp**), a subsidiary of Intuit Inc.

### Provider Statement
According to **Mailchimp's Standard Terms of Use** (`mailchimp.com/legal/terms`):
> *"By using the Service (defined below) or signing up for an account, you're agreeing to these Terms, which will result in a legal agreement between you and The Rocket Science Group LLC d/b/a Mailchimp (collectively, “Mailchimp,” “we,” or “us”). Mailchimp is part of the Intuit group of companies and our parent entity is Intuit Inc."*
